nom: TATCHA The Silk Sunscreen SPF 50 Weightless Mineral Sunscreen

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers are split: several say it controls shine and never feels greasy, while one reports it dried her skin out and triggered breakouts.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers mostly describe it as non-drying and comfortable, but a minority say it left their face tight, dry, or prone to flaking and stinging.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including dehydrated-combo and oily/combo) report mixed results, from a holy-grail fit to bad breakouts and a heavy, greasy film.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers most often report no irritation or breakouts and easy daily wear, but a few describe drying effects, stinging, redness, or clogged pores.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers report it sits well over flaky or aging skin, helps with melasma maintenance, and one credits it with reducing the look of fine lines.

concerns.aging: Reviewers managing melasma or fine lines report the sunscreen is less drying than other zinc formulas and note visible improvement in fine lines and melasma stability, with no dissent found.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it doesn't dry out their skin and feels moisturizing or comfortable; however, several others report dryness, tightness, flaking, or dry patches after use.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers with rosacea or sensitive skin report no irritation and calm skin; others report new redness, a pink film, or stinging on application.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe stinging, tightness, or irritation suggesting barrier discomfort, while many others report gentle, non-irritating wear even on reactive skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with melasma reports the product helps keep her spots from worsening; no other spot-specific dissent is present.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some who were previously breakout-free, report clogged pores, cystic-feeling bumps, or breakouts after days of use; many more reviewers report no breakouts at all, including on oily or sensitive skin.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers say it controls shine without feeling greasy or heavy; one oily-skin reviewer instead reports it stripped her skin and felt drying rather than oil-controlling.

extraits.texte: I like Tatcha a lot and really thought this product was going to work well for me. I have dehydrated combination skin. Tzone can get oily, periorbital/mouth area/lower face leans on the drier side. I dont have acne but I AM prone to getting clogged pores if I use heavy, cheap skincare. But generally speaking, depending on my skin's needs, whatever I use typically never breaks me out. That was all until I started using this stuff. After almost a week of daily use, I started breaking for out for the first time in a LONG time. I gaslighted myself into believing that it was just from me eating too many carbs, but no, it was from this sunscreen. It is way too much of a rich, greasy, heavy, formula and it doesnt absorb well at all. It leaves a thick oily pink hue/film. Its so rich that if you use any skincare underneath it, you look like you "slugged" with diaper cream. I use the proper amount of sunscreen for my face which is three solid finger lengths. It is like rubbing in motor oil. It applies like foundation and settles into eye creases in smile lines, never sets. Most importantly, this congested my pores and gave me texture so bad. In the 24 hours of stopping use, my skin is already improving and flattening out. I wouldnt never recommend this to anyone, its awful.
I have sensitive skin and have used this twice now. It is super drying and caused my face to breakout pretty badly afterwards. Wish I had saved the box so I could return.

extraits.titre: Might be good if you don't have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I wanted to love this, and upon first application I really did love it, it blended in easily, had a very silky texture and finish, and wore nicely throught the day, buy by the time came to take it off, I noticed clogged pores starting to form on my cheeks. I wanted to give it another chance so I went back to my tried and true skincare products for a few days and make sure this was the only new addition, and it was same story, I loved it on initial application, but by the end of the day my skin was irritated and had bumps. If you are acne prone, I would reccomend patch testing first. Also, it may go without saying, but the PRICE?!!! There are defiteily better options for much better prices.

I've only purchased this in the "new" packaging. Sounds like the printing on the bottle doesnt wear off now. My issues are that the lid comes off easily, and I haven't had it leak during air or car travel, picking it up by the lid from my vanity drawer has led to the lid coming off and spillage. The formula is heaven. I'm a long time Rx retinoid user with melasma and rosacea, and this is less drying than other zinc-only formulas. Summer and winter, it's easy to apply, even when i have some flaky skin, which has been the deal breaker for me and many, many, many other sunscreens. This has a tint, but it only evens my skintone slightly, if you're a foundation user, you'll still want to use it. My NARS foundation applies well over it when I have done that. On normal work days i just use concealer and finishing powder over it. I do think it helps keep my melasma from worsening on normal work days to and from the office. For gardening I typically wear something that's cheaper that i can reapply with abandon. This brand isn't ever going to get cheaper. Ulta carries Blume, which makes an almost identical sunscreen, but for some reason they aren't carrying it. Anyway, if you can afford Tatcha and are looking for a physical sunscreen that's high SPF and cosmetically elegant, this is an option you should try.

extraits.titre: Best Face Sunscreen I've Ever Used
extraits.texte: This formula is light weight and does not leave a white cast! It works well under foundation and does not pill. I find the smell to be very light upon applying but fades quickly and is not over powering. I have sensitive skin and this formula has never given me a break out or irritation!

I love this sunscreen! I was a bit skeptical since I'm oily but it does wonders! It doesn't leave a white cast like regular sunscreen and didn't make me feel greasy. I haven't worn it under makeup yet but I do love it by itself! I would definitely buy this again in the future.

extraits.titre: I will repurchase this over & over
extraits.texte: I am allergic to regular sunscreen and as an oily/combo skin it was hard finding a mineral sunscreen that wasnt oily, wouldnt clog my skin & wouldnt absorb & sit on my skin greasy all day. This tatcha sunscreen is perfect! I am on my third bottle & will continue purchasing. I have sensitive skin & this has never broke me out. In fact the opposite, its helped me clear my skin. Sure its tiny for the price but on my face its worth it. On my neck i use regular sunscreen lotion. I LOVE
